description: Every public MyAnimeList surface in one binary, plus offline analytics the site itself cannot answer

tools.name: anime_characters
tools.description: Characters and their Japanese/English voice actors for an anime. Required: id. Returns array of CharacterRole.

tools.name: anime_episodes
tools.description: Episode table with titles, air dates, poll averages, and reply counts. Required: id. Optional: page (default: 1). Returns array of Episode.

params.name: page
params.description: Episode page number (100 episodes per page)

tools.name: anime_forum
tools.description: Discussion boards attached to an anime title. Required: id. Returns array of ForumBoard.

tools.name: anime_get
tools.description: Fetch one anime title's full detail page by MyAnimeList id. Required: id. Returns the AnimeDetail.

tools.name: anime_list
tools.description: Search anime with the site's full advanced filters (query, format, score, airing status, rating, year range, genre, sort). Optional: query, format, min-score (plus 7 more). Returns array of AnimeSummary.

params.name: format
params.description: Anime format id (1 TV, 2 OVA, 3 Movie, 4 Special, 5 ONA, 6 Music, 7 CM, 8 PV, 9 TV Special)

params.name: airing-status
params.description: Airing status filter (1 airing, 2 finished, 3 not yet aired)

params.name: rating
params.description: Content rating filter (1 G, 2 PG, 3 PG-13, 4 R-17+, 5 R+, 6 Rx)

params.name: start-year
params.description: Only titles that began airing in this year or later

params.name: end-year
params.description: Only titles that began airing in this year or earlier

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order id (1 title, 2 score, 3 type, 4 start date, 5 members, 6 rated)

tools.name: anime_moreinfo
tools.description: Extended credits, external links, and full theme-song credits. Required: id. Returns the AnimeDetail.

tools.name: anime_pictures
tools.description: Image gallery (posters, key visuals, screenshots) for an anime. Required: id. Returns array of Picture.

tools.name: anime_recommendations
tools.description: Community recommendations for an anime, with recommendation counts. Required: id. Optional: page (default: 1). Returns array of Recommendation.

tools.name: anime_reviews
tools.description: Community reviews with scores, helpful counts, and spoiler flags. Required: id. Optional: page (default: 1), include-spoilers. Returns array of Review.

params.name: include-spoilers
params.description: Set to 'on' to include spoiler-tagged reviews

tools.name: anime_stats
tools.description: Score distribution (1-10 with vote counts) and status distribution for an anime. Required: id. Returns the TitleStats.

tools.name: anime_streaming
tools.description: Streaming episodes and promos for an anime (the site's own video JSON, no auth) with a real pager. Required: id. Optional: page (default: 1). Returns array of StreamingVideo.

params.name: id
params.description: MyAnimeList anime id (the upstream key is `id`, not `anime_id`)

tools.name: anime_videos
tools.description: Promotional videos and trailers for an anime. Required: id. Returns array of Video.

tools.name: character_get
tools.description: A character's profile with appearances and voice actors. Required: id. Returns the CharacterDetail.

tools.name: feed_featured
tools.description: Featured-article RSS feed (XML). Returns array of NewsItem.

tools.name: feed_news
tools.description: News RSS feed (XML). Returns array of NewsItem.

tools.name: feed_user
tools.description: A member's public activity feed (needs ?u=; without it the endpoint 404s). Required: feed-type, username. Returns array of NewsItem.

params.name: feed-type
params.description: Feed kind: rw recent anime updates, rm recent manga updates, rwe recently watched episodes, rrm recently read chapters

tools.name: forum_boards
tools.description: All forum boards with their current topic counts. Returns array of ForumBoard.

tools.name: forum_topic
tools.description: One forum topic and its posts. Required: topic-id. Returns the ForumTopicDetail.

tools.name: forum_topics
tools.description: Topics in one forum board. Required: board. Optional: page (default: 1). Returns array of ForumTopic.

tools.name: genre_anime
tools.description: Anime in a genre, theme, or demographic. Required: id. Optional: page (default: 1). Returns array of RankedTitle.

tools.name: genre_manga
tools.description: Manga in a genre, theme, or demographic. Required: id. Optional: page (default: 1). Returns array of RankedTitle.

tools.name: instant_search
tools.description: Instant search across anime, manga, characters, and people (the site's own suggest API, JSON). Required: query, entity-type. Returns the SuggestResult.

tools.name: magazine_get
tools.description: A magazine's page with every serialized title. Required: id. Optional: page (default: 1). Returns array of RankedTitle.

tools.name: manga_characters
tools.description: Characters credited in a manga. Required: id. Returns array of CharacterRole.

tools.name: manga_get
tools.description: Fetch one manga title's full detail page by MyAnimeList id. Required: id. Returns the MangaDetail.

tools.name: manga_list
tools.description: Search manga with the site's advanced filters. Optional: query, format, min-score (plus 7 more). Returns array of MangaSummary.

params.name: format
params.description: Manga format id (1 Manga, 2 Novel, 3 One-shot, 4 Doujin, 5 Manhwa, 6 Manhua)

params.name: publish-status
params.description: Publication status filter (1 publishing, 2 finished, 3 not yet published)

params.name: start-year
params.description: Only titles that began publishing in this year or later

params.name: end-year
params.description: Only titles that began publishing in this year or earlier

tools.name: manga_moreinfo
tools.description: Extended credits and external links for a manga. Required: id. Returns the MangaDetail.

tools.name: manga_pictures
tools.description: Image gallery for a manga. Required: id. Returns array of Picture.

tools.name: manga_recommendations
tools.description: Community recommendations for a manga. Required: id. Optional: page (default: 1). Returns array of Recommendation.

tools.name: manga_reviews
tools.description: Community reviews for a manga. Required: id. Optional: page (default: 1). Returns array of Review.

tools.name: manga_stats
tools.description: Score distribution and status distribution for a manga. Required: id. Returns the TitleStats.

tools.name: member_anime-list
tools.description: A public anime list as JSON rows (status, score, progress, tags); no credential required. Required: username. Optional: offset (default: 0), list-status. Returns array of ListRow.

params.name: list-status
params.description: Only rows with this list status (1 watching, 2 completed, 3 on-hold, 4 dropped, 6 plan-to-watch, 7 all)

tools.name: member_get
tools.description: A public member profile: statistics, favorites, and recent activity (no credential required). Required: username. Returns the UserProfile.

tools.name: member_manga-list
tools.description: A public manga list as JSON rows; no credential required. Required: username. Optional: offset (default: 0), list-status. Returns array of ListRow.

params.name: list-status
params.description: Only rows with this list status

tools.name: member_statistics
tools.description: A member's public aggregate statistics. Required: username. Returns the UserProfile.

tools.name: news_get
tools.description: A single news article, body included. Required: id. Returns the NewsArticle.

tools.name: news_list
tools.description: Latest news headlines with pagination. Optional: page (default: 1). Returns array of NewsItem.

tools.name: person_get
tools.description: A person's page: animeography, voice roles, and staff credits. Required: id. Returns the PersonDetail.

tools.name: ranking_anime
tools.description: Top anime by type: all, airing, upcoming, tv, movie, ova, ona, special, bypopularity, favorite. Optional: list, page (default: 1), limit (default: 50). Returns array of RankedTitle.

params.name: limit
params.description: Rank offset into the list (an offset, not a page size: limit=50 starts at rank 51)

tools.name: ranking_manga
tools.description: Top manga by type: all, manga, novels, lightnovels, oneshots, doujin, manhwa, manhua, bypopularity, favorite. Optional: list, page (default: 1), limit (default: 50). Returns array of RankedTitle.

params.name: limit
params.description: Rank offset into the list (an offset, not a page size: limit=50 starts at rank 51)

tools.name: season_archive
tools.description: Index of every past season. Returns array of SeasonArchiveEntry.

tools.name: season_current
tools.description: The season airing right now. Returns array of SeasonEntry.

tools.name: season_later
tools.description: Upcoming seasons announced but not yet airing (the `upcoming` path 404s; `later` is the real route). Returns array of SeasonEntry.

tools.name: season_list
tools.description: Full seasonal chart for a year and season, grouped by format. Required: year, season. Optional: page (default: 1). Returns array of SeasonEntry.

tools.name: season_schedule
tools.description: The weekly airing schedule, optionally shifted to a timezone the site understands. Optional: timezone. Returns array of ScheduleEntry.

params.name: timezone
params.description: IANA timezone the site should render the schedule in (e.g. America/Phoenix)

tools.name: sitemap_index
tools.description: Sitemap index listing every catalog shard (XML). Returns array of SitemapRef.

tools.name: sitemap_shard
tools.description: One sitemap shard, e.g. anime-001, manga-001, character-001, people-001, news-001 (XML). Required: shard. Returns array of SitemapRef.

tools.name: studio_get
tools.description: A studio's or licensor's page with its full production list. Required: id. Optional: page (default: 1). Returns array of RankedTitle.

novel_features.name: Divisiveness index
novel_features.description: See whether a title is universally loved or bitterly split, instead of reading one average score.

novel_features.name: Reception drift and movers
novel_features.description: See how a title's score, member count, favorites, and rank have moved since you last looked.

novel_features.name: Weekly viewing grid
novel_features.description: Get a timezone-correct seven-day grid of just the shows you track, with same-hour collisions flagged.

novel_features.name: Drop-risk score
novel_features.description: Judge how likely a title is to be abandoned before you commit dozens of episodes to it.

novel_features.name: Episode reception curve
novel_features.description: See whether a show improves, holds, or falls apart across its episodes using per-episode poll data.

novel_features.name: Anime-to-manga source coverage
novel_features.description: Learn whether an anime covered its source manga and how much source material is left.

novel_features.name: Franchise gap finder
novel_features.description: Find the sequel, movie, or side story you skipped in every franchise you have already started.
